text.p: AccelGraphics Inc announced Friday the initial public offering and trading of 2.6 million shares of its common stock on the Nasdaq National Market at a price of $9.00 per share.
Of the total, 2,145,000 shares were offered by the company and 455,000 shares were offered by selling stockholders.
Cowen & Co lead-managed the underwriting group and Robertson, Stephens & Co and SoundView Financial Group served as co-managers.

The net proceeds to the company from the offering will be used for the repayment of debt, working capital, capital expenditures, research and development and potential acquisitions of businesses and technologies.

AccelGraphics, Inc., headquartered in San Jose, California, provides 3-dimensional graphics subsystems, software accelerators and application utility software products for the professional Windows markets.
